detail.longDescription: @ink@social.xenofem.me thx. i’m usually hacking in the shadows as they say but this time i figured it would be fun to dogfood the thing im building, dropping devlogs as i go. even with #ai operating as lift-assist on cofe project it takes time to do it right. not sure what the end goal is beyond “build a fediverse backend/frontend just for me that follows spec and good enough interop”. a lot of how i approach engineering is how i do it professionally. i just wired up hot-roll releases on #kubernetes so as soon as master merges cluster picks up the release and flips the deployment. another thing i’m working on is a 30min federation / interop test where pipeline matrix spins up two cofe instances and one of #pleroma #mastodon #mitra and #gotosocial. being able to talk with folks on disparate instances is important to me.
